title: Opening: name, birthplace and birth date
summary: Compton gives his name, Harrodsburg, Kentucky birthplace and January 6, 1884 birth date.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Okay, it's going. You can give your name first, Mr. Compton, your full name.
Well, my name is Glover John Compton.
Can you tell your exact birth date?
Yes. January the 6th. 1884. A long time ago, isn't it?

Yeah, how old does that make you now? 75. 75, oh yeah. You look good for your age. Yes, I'm glad of that. Wish I was good as I look. Can you tell us about when you first started in music? Did your parents play any musical instruments? How did you get into music?
